subject.title: message tool: Feishu send action polluted by poll schema/guard prevents file send

question: Should OpenClaw hide or ignore poll creation fields for `message.send`, or keep the current content-bearing poll guard as the intended shared message-tool contract?
rationale: The narrow metadata-only fix is already shipped, but solving the remaining issue changes the model-facing schema/validation boundary shared by Feishu, Telegram, Discord, and other channel actions.

options.title: Use action-scoped schemas
options.body: Expose poll creation fields only for explicit poll actions or channel-owned poll schemas, so generic sends cannot be polluted by those fields.

options.title: Sanitize all poll fields on send
options.body: Strip or ignore poll creation fields on `action="send"` before the guard, preserving delivery at the cost of masking accidental poll intent.

options.title: Keep the narrowed guard
options.body: Treat `pollQuestion` or `pollOption` on send as a hard error and close the broader schema-shape request as not planned.

recommendation.title: Use action-scoped schemas
recommendation.body: Expose poll creation fields only for explicit poll actions or channel-owned poll schemas, so generic sends cannot be polluted by those fields.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the clearest history on the shared poll/schema behavior and related message-tool parsing changes.
